metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Biju Patnaik Airport decrease more than the brightness at Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) “VNP46A1” daily composites since these directly capture nighttime brightness. - Date: April 30, 2019 (day 120) vs May 5, 2019 (day 125). - Location: • Biju Patnaik Airport ≈ 20.2563° N, 85.8168° E • Saheed Nagar provided as 20.290813, 85.848691 - Band: “NTL_Ref” (DNB radiance in nW cm⁻² sr⁻¹). 2. Masking / QA: - VNP46A1 already flags clouds and stray-light using QC_flag; QC_flag = 0 means best quality pixels. We’ll keep only those. - Units are physical radiance so values ≥ 0 are valid; very large numbers (≫100) would indicate an issue. 3. Decision logic: - Compute mean radiance at both points on the two dates. - Compute change: ΔAirport = May5 – Apr30; ΔSaheed = May5 – Apr30. - If ΔAirport < ΔSaheed (i.e., airport DID “decrease more”), answer is A; else B. - If either image is missing → C1. - After cloud/missing masking: if 0 pixels at any date/roi → C2. - If returned value is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
airport = ee.Geometry.Point(85.8168, 20.2563)
saheed = ee.Geometry.Point(85.848691, 20.290813)
apr30 = '2019-04-30'
may5 = '2019-05-05'

# 2. Acquire VIIRS daily DNB collection & keep QC_flag=0
def get_clear(img, pt):
    ic = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A1')
          .filterDate(img, ee.Date(img).advance(1, 'day'))
          .select(['NTRL','QC_flag','gap_filled'])
          .filterBounds(pt)
          .map(lambda i: i.updateMask(i.select('QC_flag').eq(0))
                         .updateMask(i.select('gap_filled').eq(0))))
    return ic.first()

def get_mean(img_name, pt):
    img = get_clear(img_name, pt)
    if img is None:
        return (None, 0)
    count = img.select('NTRL').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NTRL').getInfo()
    if count == 0:
        return (None, 0)
    mean = img.select('NTRL').reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NTRL').getInfo()
    return (mean, count)

# 3. Retrieve brightness values
airport_apr, cA = get_mean(apr30, airport)
airport_may, cB = get_mean(may5, airport)
saheed_apr, cC = get_mean(apr30, saheed)
saheed_may, cD = get_mean(may5, saheed)

# 4. Check availability
if any(x is None for x in [airport_apr, airport_may, saheed_apr, saheed_may]):
    print("Missing data, images or valid pixels.")
    if (cA+cB+cC+cD) == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif any(x<0 or x>200 for x in [airport_apr,airport_may,saheed_apr,saheed_may]):
    print("Unphysical radiance.",
          f"Airport apr={airport_apr}, may={airport_may}; Saheed apr={saheed_apr}, may={saheed_may}")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    dAir = airport_may - airport_apr
    dSah = saheed_may - saheed_apr
    print(f"Airport: apr={airport_apr:.2f} → may={airport_may:.2f} Δ={dAir:.2f}, pixels={cA} & {cB}")
    print(f"Saheed: apr={saheed_apr:.2f} → may={saheed_may:.2f} Δ={dSah:.2f}, pixels={cC} & {cD}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if dAir < dSah else "<answer>B</answer>")
